# Architecture Blueprint & Guidelines
- Architecture target: Next.js 16+ App Router, React 19.2+, TypeScript 5.5+
- Style engine: Tailwind CSS v4.x (OKLCH Color Space)
- Swiss Light Mode Design Doctrine: Strict adherence to light mode, OKLCH, and glassmorphism. Dark mode forbidden.
- Zero-New-Routes Invariant: Existing architecture is fixed. Enhance existing pages >800 words and add specific interactive elements.
- Strict Types: No Enums, no implicit `any`, use `as const` and `satisfies`.
